items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 September 2026 11:08am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 18 September 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

Deepening area of low pressure near Iceland as a frontal zone affects the British Isles.


##Wind##

Southwest 5 or 6, quickly increasing 6 to gale 8, then decreasing 5 or 6 again this evening, perhaps occasionally force 7 in the east until later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, quickly building moderate or rough, then mainly moderate again later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, perhaps poor at times in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, veering west or northwest 4 or 5 later Sunday morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.
